H.title: The Big Bang
H.description: In the first fraction of a second, the universe exploded into being as pure energy.

H.title: Primordial Nucleosynthesis
H.description: Protons and neutrons collided in cosmic furnaces, and you were born as the universe's first nucleus.

H.title: The First Stars Ignite
H.description: Hydrogen clouds collapsed under gravity, and the first stars blazed to life, burning you as their fuel.

H.title: Stellar Furnaces
H.description: Throughout cosmic history, you fused into helium in countless stars, powering the light of galaxies.

H.title: Stellar Winds Release
H.description: Aging stars shed you into space through gentle winds and violent supernovae.

H.title: Interstellar Wandering
H.description: You drifted through nebulae and stellar nurseries, carried on cosmic winds and radiation.

H.title: Earth's Waters
H.description: You arrived on a young Earth and combined with oxygen to form the oceans, the cradle of all life.

He.title: The Big Bang
He.description: In the first moments of creation, your nucleus formed from the universe's primordial fire.

He.title: Cosmic Abundance
He.description: You became the second most abundant element, filling the young universe alongside hydrogen.

He.title: The First Stars
He.description: Within massive stars, you were fused from hydrogen, powering the cosmos itself.

He.title: Stellar Synthesis
He.description: In countless stellar cores, you were created and scattered, enriching the universe.

He.title: Stellar Ejection
He.description: You were expelled from dying stars, ejected by their final gasps into space.

He.title: Galactic Journey
He.description: You drifted through galaxies as part of nebulae and the interstellar wind.

He.title: Earth's Atmosphere
He.description: You arrived on Earth and became a trace element in the upper atmosphere, escaping gravity itself.

Li.title: The Big Bang
Li.description: You were forged in the first three minutes of existence, a relic of the primordial furnace.

Li.title: Cosmic Rarity
Li.description: Among the rare nuclei created at the beginning, lithium was precious and sparse.

Li.title: First Stars Form
Li.description: Massive stars ignited, burning hydrogen but leaving rare lithium largely untouched.

Li.title: Stellar Survival
Li.description: You survived in stellar atmospheres, created occasionally when cosmic rays struck atoms.

Li.title: Supernova Scattering
Li.description: A massive star's death sent you spiraling outward into the interstellar medium.

Li.title: Ancient Wandering
Li.description: You traveled through countless nebulae, your rarity making you a prized cosmic artifact.

Li.title: Arrival on Earth
Li.description: You arrived on Earth and became incorporated into rocks and minerals that sustain life.

C.title: The Big Bang
C.description: The universe ignited into existence, setting the stage for chemistry itself.

C.title: First Generation Stars
C.description: The first massive stars formed from primordial hydrogen and helium.

C.title: A Star is Born
C.description: A medium-mass star like our Sun ignited, carrying you in its core.

C.title: The Cosmic Forge
C.description: Deep in stellar furnaces, you were forged through triple-alpha fusion, the basis for all life.

C.title: Planetary Nebula
C.description: Your star exhausted its fuel and shed you gently into space through a delicate planetary nebula.

C.title: Cosmic Drifting
C.description: You drifted through the galaxy as part of stellar dust, waiting to find a home.

C.title: Life on Earth
C.description: You arrived on Earth and became the backbone of every living thing.

N.title: The Cosmic Beginning
N.description: From the Big Bang's fury came the seeds of all elements.

N.title: Early Furnaces
N.description: The first stars ignited and began the cosmic forge.

N.title: A Star is Kindled
N.description: A medium-mass star formed and began its long journey of creation.

N.title: Nuclear Alchemy
N.description: Within stellar furnaces, you were synthesized from carbon, crucial for all protein.

N.title: Stellar Farewell
N.description: Your star gently shed you through a delicate planetary nebula.

N.title: Interstellar Journey
N.description: You drifted through space on stellar winds and radiation pressure.

N.title: Life's Essential Element
N.description: You reached Earth and became essential to DNA and proteins.

O.title: Creation's Fire
O.description: The Big Bang released infinite potential into the cosmos.

O.title: First Furnaces
O.description: Massive stars ignited and began forging heavier elements.

O.title: A Middle Star Forms
O.description: A medium-sized star, destined to harbor life, was born.

O.title: The Forge
O.description: You were fused in stellar furnaces, becoming the breath of all living things.

O.title: The Star's Swan Song
O.description: Your star gently released you into a planetary nebula, its final gift.

O.title: The Cosmic Void
O.description: You traveled through space, seeking a world that would need you.

O.title: Earth's First Breath
O.description: You arrived on Earth and became the essence of water and air.

Fe.title: The Big Bang's Prologue
Fe.description: The universe erupted into being, dense and infinitely hot.

Fe.title: Stellar Nurseries
Fe.description: The first stars formed and began their cosmic work.

Fe.title: A Massive Star Ignites
Fe.description: A stellar giant was born, destined for a violent and apocalyptic end.

Fe.title: The Stellar Furnace
Fe.description: Deep in the star's core, you were forged from silicon through nuclear fusion.

Fe.title: Supernova: The Final Explosion
Fe.description: Your star's core collapsed and rebounded in a catastrophic supernova, scattering you across light-years.

Fe.title: Through the Cosmos
Fe.description: You drifted through interstellar dust clouds, gathering cosmic companions.

Fe.title: Earth's Heart
Fe.description: You arrived on Earth and sank to its core, becoming the planet's beating heart.

Si.title: The Beginning
Si.description: The Big Bang released all possibility into the void.

Si.title: First Stars Rise
Si.description: The first massive stars ignited across the young universe.

Si.title: A Giant Star Forms
Si.description: A massive star was born, destined to create the building blocks of worlds.

Si.title: Silicon's Birth
Si.description: In the star's core, you were fused from oxygen, becoming the architect of planets.

Si.title: Supernova Fury
Si.description: Your star exploded in a catastrophic supernova, blasting you into the cosmos.

Si.title: Interstellar Voyage
Si.description: You traveled through nebulae and dust clouds, part of the stellar scaffold.

Si.title: Planetary Foundation
Si.description: You arrived on Earth and became the foundation of mountains, sand, and stone.

Mg.title: The Universe Awakens
Mg.description: From the Big Bang came all things.

Mg.title: First Light
Mg.description: Massive stars ignited and began their fusion.

Mg.title: A Stellar Giant Forms
Mg.description: A massive star was born, destined to die young and violently.

Mg.title: Creation in the Core
Mg.description: In stellar furnaces, you were synthesized, a crucial metal for worlds.

Mg.title: Stellar Death
Mg.description: Your star exploded as a supernova, its death your liberation into space.

Mg.title: The Stellar Wind
Mg.description: You drifted through space on shock waves and radiation.

Mg.title: Earth's Green
Mg.description: You arrived on Earth and became the heart of chlorophyll, powering photosynthesis.

S.title: Stellar Genesis
S.description: The first stars formed and began synthesizing heavier elements.

S.title: A Massive Star Emerges
S.description: A giant star was born, carrying your future within it.

S.title: Sulfur Forged
S.description: In the star's core, nuclear reactions created you from silicon and oxygen.

S.title: Apocalyptic Supernova
S.description: Your star collapsed and exploded, hurling you into the void.

S.title: Cosmic Wandering
S.description: You drifted through nebulae, part of interstellar dust.

S.title: Earth's Chemistry
S.description: You arrived on Earth and became essential to proteins and life's chemistry.

Au.title: Cosmic History
Au.description: The first stars formed but could not yet create gold.

Au.title: Neutron Stars Converge
Au.description: Two neutron stars, remnants of ancient supernovae, spiraled toward their final dance.

Au.title: The Merger Approaches
Au.description: Drawn by gravity's pull, the neutron stars drew ever closer.

Au.title: Kilonova: Cosmic Violence
Au.description: You were forged in the violent merger of neutron stars, born from cosmic violence itself.

Au.title: Through the Stars
Au.description: You drifted through the galaxy as part of the merger's ejecta.

Au.title: Earth's Treasure
Au.description: You arrived on Earth and became the rarest, most precious element in human history.

Pt.title: The Universe Begins
Pt.description: The Big Bang released infinite potential.

Pt.title: Neutron Star Dance
Pt.description: Two neutron stars spiraled together, drawn by gravity's inevitable pull.

Pt.title: The Final Approach
Pt.description: The neutron stars drew ever closer, their fate sealed.

Pt.title: Kilonova Release
Pt.description: You were liberated in a neutron star merger explosion, one of the universe's most violent events.

Pt.title: Cosmic Journey
Pt.description: You drifted through the cosmos as part of the merger's noble debris.

Pt.title: Earth's Rarity
Pt.description: You arrived on Earth, one of the rarest atoms, born only from cosmic violence.

U.title: The Big Bang
U.description: The universe was born in a moment of infinite creation.

U.title: First Stars
U.description: Massive stars ignited and began fusing elements.

U.title: Neutron Star Pair
U.description: Two massive stars' deaths created a pair of orbiting neutron stars.

U.title: Spiraling Together
U.description: The neutron stars orbited closer, drawn inexorably by gravity.

U.title: The Kilonova
U.description: You were forged in a neutron star collision through r-process nucleosynthesis, the universe's most extreme alchemy.

U.title: Radioactive Wandering
U.description: You drifted through space, your radioactive pulse a cosmic timer.

U.title: Earth's Ancient Heart
U.description: You arrived on Earth and became a measure of geological time itself.
